world.reduced_motion_note: Reduced motion: the island holds still
world.controls_hint: Drag to pan · Scroll to zoom · Arrow keys to move · Click a building to turn it
world.rotate_hint: Drag the knob around the building to turn it. Shift snaps to 15° steps.
world.rotate_reset_all: Turn every building back to its designed heading
world.minimap_label: Island map — click to jump there
world.webgl_missing_body: This window cannot draw 3D right now. The ledger lists the same agents.
world.drawer_foundry_hint: Where new agents are made. Whoever is built steps out of the portal and rides the conveyor down to the square.
world.foundry_walkout: A freshly built agent comes through the portal and finds its place in the village.
world.drawer_plugins_hint: Every plugin installed in this app, by family. An agent walks here when its run leans on a plugin.
world.quest_add_placeholder: New quest… e.g. the five most important mails of today
world.quest_wait_approval: {agent} is waiting for your approval in its chat — the quest starts right after
world.quest_wait_busy: {agent} is busy — the quest starts as soon as it is free
world.drawer_quests_hint: Post a job. The agent who fits takes it — when nobody fits, the Foundry forges one.
world.quest_compose_placeholder: What should be done? For example: the five most important mails of today
world.quest_empty: No quests yet. Post the first one.
world.drawer_skills_hint: Every skill this app knows. Drafts an agent learned wait here for your approval.
world.drawer_mcp_hint: The MCP servers this app can reach. The dish turns while an agent calls one.
world.drawer_cli_hint: The coding CLIs and seats. An agent sits at a terminal here while a coding session runs.
world.drawer_foundry_body: A new agent is created here and walks out of this door to its own house on the ring. Use “New” in the agents rail to create one; avatar changes happen inside as well.
world.drawer_memory_hint: The agents' shared memory: reviewed team knowledge, every agent's own memory and the review queue. An agent walks here when it remembers or looks something up.
world.memory_empty_shared: No reviewed team knowledge yet. Agents' proposals land in the queue below.
